classes.purpose: Data-registry for level-up 'box' rewards. An entry lists {boxRewardId, rollCount} pairs (this+0xc..0x10, stride 8). notes: All 12 are C*Info data-registry classes. The auto-labeler tagged every method 'GetManagers' because each inlines the class's CInfoManager singleton accessor, whose profiler-scope string literal ('ClassName::GetManagers') is the genuine name of that small accessor. Standard CInfoManager id->entry lookup idiom recurs everywhere: idx = id - mgr[0x30]; block = mgr[0x20][idx/mgr[0x28]]; entry = block[idx%mgr[0x28]] (deque), or contiguous vector at mgr+0x14/0x18 or mgr[5]/mgr[6]. No DebugFormat printers or XML/TLV readers appear in these bundles, so field names/offsets are inferred from control flow except CExpressionInfo, which was cross-checked against ExpressionItem.md (id/level/point/collectlevel). Confidence is medium/low accordingly.
